name: SecretVault RAM sealing

test_list.description: Bytes sealed by a vault open to the original bytes, and the returned plaintext is zeroizing.
Any modified authenticated ciphertext fails closed with the typed open error.
Independent seals use independently generated 96-bit nonces.
A sealed secret cannot be opened under a different secret name.
The session key uses a distinct heap allocation from every stored ciphertext.
Inputs above the explicit per-secret bound are rejected before encryption.

inputs.name: plaintext
inputs.description: Bounded secret bytes that must not be retained in plaintext after scoped use.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Validated name used as authenticated associated data.

output_description: Authenticated ciphertext and a random nonce, or a typed error that never includes secret material.
